Although the paper also includes synthetic and GloVe/LSTM comparisons, the study clearly includes and analyzes Transformer language models with empirical syntax-focused experiments, satisfying both required inclusion criteria.

support_spans.quote: We focus on three syntactic phenomena
The Subject-Verb Agreement (SVA) construction requires detecting whether the verb agrees in number with its subject
The Negative Polarity Items (NPI) construction requires detecting whether a negative polarity item (e.g., “any”, “ever”) is grammatical in a given context
The Filler-Gap Dependencies (GAP) construction requires detecting whether a sentence containing a gap is grammatical
